credibilityEvidence: Section 2: four harness mechanisms (action fusion, online context compact, ObservationPack, evidence-preserving reducer) each tied to an ablation in Section 3

candidates.presentationReason: Explicit Limitations and Future Directions section separates demonstrated results from aspirational framing
candidates.noveltyReason: Treats the harness itself as the object of an RSI-style auto-research loop, rather than optimizing the underlying model
candidates.todayImportanceReason: From an NVIDIA/MIT team with released code, showing double-digit percentage cost cuts on production-style harnesses is immediately actionable
candidates.practicalLinkReason: The four surviving mechanisms are drop-in candidates for teams running Claude Code-, Codex-style harnesses at scale where per-token cost matters
